shared.mockNotice: This page uses synthetic mock data and does not connect to real materials, accounts, or media services.
shared.empty: There are no synthetic records to display.
shared.forbidden: Sign-in and project ownership verification are required.
shared.recovering: Your last saved page progress is available and safe to resume.
shared.notScored: This does not affect scores or unlock status.

landing.title: Turn every practice round into an explainable next step
landing.lead: From material review and plan confirmation to round-by-round reflection, every state explains impact, retention, and recovery.
landing.privacyBody: Materials enter their assigned data region only after you submit them. The visitor demo never touches personal data.
landing.ageBody: Users under 16 may only use this page's no-sign-in, no-upload sample demo. Personalized services require a minimum age of 16.
landing.boundaryBody: This product supports mock training and reflection. It does not predict hiring, answer real interviews, or submit job applications.
landing.empty: The product introduction is temporarily unavailable. Refresh to retry.
landing.forbidden: This page is open to visitors; uploading personal materials requires sign-in.
landing.recovering: The introduction has returned to its default state after refresh.

demo.title: Sample demo
demo.lead: Preview the full training journey with a fictional product operations role.
demo.signalOne: Experience is explained with a clear structure
demo.signalTwo: Data validation steps could be more specific
demo.signalThree: Next: practice adding evidence during follow-ups
demo.dataNotice: Every name, role, material, and result is synthetic and contains no personal data.
demo.empty: The demo resource is empty and no personal data is affected.
demo.forbidden: The sample demo is available without an account.
demo.recovering: The demo returned to the beginning and saved no visitor progress.

auth.title: Sign in or create an account
auth.lead: Choose a way to continue. A phone number is never required.
auth.codeHint: The code is valid for 10 minutes and can be resent after 60 seconds.
auth.invalidCode: The code is incorrect. Four attempts remain; your email is retained. Resend after the 60-second cooldown.
auth.providerFailed: Third-party authorization is unavailable. Continue with an email code instead.
auth.terms: I have read the Terms of Service
auth.privacy: I have read the Privacy Policy
auth.processing: I have read the Data Processing Notice
auth.separateConsent: Recording, organization sharing, and model training are authorized separately in context and are not bundled with registration.
auth.age: I confirm that I am at least 16
auth.ageHint: Users aged 16 to their local age of majority follow the guardian verification process.
auth.returnHint: After sign-in, you will return to the upload action you selected.
auth.empty: No sign-in method is selected. You can start with email verification.
auth.forbidden: Security policy requires a risk check before sign-in can continue.
auth.recovering: Your email address and pre-sign-in action context have been restored.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lead: Organize mock interviews by status and next action.
dashboard.legend: All project statuses and available actions
dashboard.actionHint: Actions are determined by current status
dashboard.empty: No interview projects yet. Start with a synthetic sample or a new project.
dashboard.forbidden: Only the account owner can view the project list.
dashboard.recovering: Filters were restored from the URL and project data remains in your account.
dashboard.failureImpact: Project data remains in your account and scores and entitlements are unaffected.

create.title: Create interview project
create.lead: Resume and job description inputs stay separate, so a failure in one never clears the other.
create.uploadHint: PDF, DOC, or DOCX; one file up to 10 MB.
create.processing: File selected and waiting for a security check
create.jdPlaceholder: Paste responsibilities, requirements, and work location…
create.sampleMark: Synthetic sample materials are in use
create.rejected: File rejected: only unencrypted, intact PDF/DOC/DOCX files up to 10 MB are accepted. Your JD text is fully retained.
create.draftRestored: Your last saved draft was restored.
create.empty: No materials yet. You may also try a synthetic sample first.
create.forbidden: Sign in to create a project, then return to this page.
create.recovering: The last edited JD and file-processing state were restored.

review.title: Review parsed materials
review.parsingHint: Running safety checks, extracting structure, and marking confidence. Usually complete within 60 seconds (P95).
review.sensitiveTitle: Sensitive fields excluded from the interview
review.sensitiveHint: Only excluded category names appear here; no field values are displayed.
review.categories: Phone, email, identity number, detailed address, photo, gender, marital or parental status
review.missingBody: Only a JD is available, so a general role interview will be used. Missing resume facts are never inferred as candidate experience.
review.missingConsent: I understand and accept this degraded mode and its impact
review.materialsConfirmed: I have confirmed every material field
review.generateDisabled: Confirm the materials and accept the missing-material impact first
review.failed: Parsing was interrupted. The original resume and JD are retained.
review.empty: There are no parsed fields to review yet.
review.forbidden: Only the material owner can view and review these fields.
review.recovering: The material-review state and unconfirmed edits were restored.

plan.title: Interview plan
plan.generatingHint: Rounds, rubrics, coverage, and quote are generated in parallel, usually within 120 seconds (P95).
plan.accommodationHint: All nine settings default off and operate independently. Accommodations are not scoring evidence; oral skills in text mode are not evaluated and never scored as zero.
plan.readonlyBody: The unified scoring algorithm, 60-point threshold, unlock logic, and cross-round handoff rules cannot be edited. Formal questions and model answers never appear here.
plan.confirmDisabled: A round is missing its question coverage plan or scoring rubric
plan.partialFailed: The rubric module failed; successful rounds and source modules are retained.
plan.frozen: The plan is confirmed and frozen. Every editing control is read only.
plan.quote: Quote: 2 rounds · 70 minutes · 1 formal retry entitlement · taxes included · valid for 24 hours
plan.empty: There are no plan modules to display.
plan.forbidden: Only the project owner can review and confirm the plan.
plan.recovering: Unconfirmed round order and accommodations were restored.

precheck.title: Pre-interview check
precheck.lead: Run and retry each check independently, then confirm accommodations and entitlement before starting.
precheck.mediaHint: Turning off camera or microphone never affects scores. Text input remains available.
precheck.deviceFailure: The device is busy or permission was denied. Close the other app or use text input.
precheck.networkFailure: The network is weak. Switch connections or choose a nearby node.
precheck.avatarExpectation: 95% connect within 8 seconds. Failures retry automatically and support remains available.
precheck.settingsHint: Inherited from the prior round and adjustable before starting. They freeze after start; system degradation is the only exception.
precheck.frozen: Round accommodations are confirmed. They remain visible before start and cannot change after start.
precheck.quotaInsufficient: Available entitlement is insufficient, so starting is blocked.
precheck.startDisabled: Entitlement is insufficient or checks are incomplete
precheck.transfer: This project is active on another device. Transfer it safely first.
precheck.empty: No pre-interview checks have run yet.
precheck.forbidden: Access requires project ownership and a successful single-active-device check.
precheck.recovering: Each check result was restored, and retries do not create duplicate requests.
